level_title: Boss Trial: Chronos-If, The Loop Warden

questions.title: Phase 1: Conditional Shield Breach (if / else)
questions.prompt: Chronos-If raises a Temporal Barrier! Complete the conditional check to fire your spell only when 'mana' is greater than or equal to 50.
questions.hint: Master PyWizard says: The 'greater than or equal to' comparison operator in Python combines '>' and '=' into '>='.
questions.explanation: Direct hit! 'mana >= 50' evaluates to True when mana is 75, executing the indented block inside the if statement.

questions.title: Phase 2: Multi-Branch Countermeasure (if / elif / else)
questions.prompt: Chronos-If shifts elemental phases! Which Python keyword checks a SECOND condition only if the first 'if' condition was False?
questions.hint: Master PyWizard says: Python shortens 'else if' into a single 4-letter keyword!
questions.explanation: Bullseye! Python uses 'elif' for chained conditional branches between 'if' and 'else'.

questions.title: Phase 3: Rapid-Fire Volley (for loop & range)
questions.prompt: Unleash a 5-hit Arcane Barrage to shatter the Warden's armor! Fill in the built-in function that generates a sequence of 5 numbers (0 through 4).
questions.hint: Master PyWizard says: In Python, 'for i in range(5):' repeats the loop body 5 times!
questions.explanation: Critical Barrage! 'range(5)' generates 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, causing the for-loop to fire 5 consecutive bolts!

questions.title: Phase 4: Breaking the Infinite Loop (while loop)
questions.prompt: Chronos-If traps the arena in a time loop! What happens inside this 'while' loop to prevent it from running forever?
questions.code_snippet:
boss_shields = 3
while boss_shields > 0:
    strike_shield()
    boss_shields = boss_shields - 1
options: 'boss_shields' is decreased by 1 each iteration until 'boss_shields > 0' becomes False
The while loop only runs once just like an if statement
'boss_shields > 0' is always False from the start
Python automatically stops all while loops after 3 seconds
questions.hint: Master PyWizard says: Look at the last line inside the loop: 'boss_shields = boss_shields - 1'.
questions.explanation: Time Loop shattered! Updating the loop variable ('boss_shields = boss_shields - 1') ensures the condition 'boss_shields > 0' eventually becomes False.

questions.explanation: VICTORY! You combined a 'for' loop with a nested 'if' condition to defeat Chronos-If, The Infinite Loop Warden!
